**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, 02:12–02:14Z) flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. Config generation 119 applied at 02:13:41Z. The pool maxes out at 20 connections and stopped freeing them, so every request queues behind `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`.

**Impact window:** Started 2026-03-14T02:14:18.972Z (first 503, `req-07401`). Still ongoing as of the last log line, 03:59:27Z. Not self-healing — the wait queue grew from 18 requests to 74 over that stretch.

**Scope:** Gateway only. `logs/worker.log` runs clean through the same window, apart from one unrelated slow-query warning at 02:36 tagged as known issue `OPS-2210`.

**Roll back:** `dep-4471` on gateway. Revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`.
